Simplifications that change behaviour

    Glossary

    Rounds

    75-minute session; the third round belongs to the 90-minute session
    10:00
    Deletes the saved plans, the exit-sheet answers, the round and all lever and setting changes in this browser. Use it before a new session.

    Facilitator tools

    Plans are stored in each browser. For the shared display, each table downloads its plan from Compare plans; import the files there. The same file imported twice is not added twice.

    Briefing

    The rules, and three questions to answer by playing

    Role cards

    Positions to argue from, not portraits of any organisation

    Debrief

    What happened, why, and what it means

    Exit sheet

    Five questions. Answers stay in this browser until downloaded.
    Approximate numbers from the TaqSim Zarafshan model; one hydrological year (October to September) in monthly steps. Reference model: src/zarafshan_taqsim/workshop/zarafshan_game.py on TaqSim ; this page reproduces it to rounding error (water-balance residual of the current run: Mm³). Pre-computed plans: NSGA-II, . hydrosolutions, TaqSim workshop, Tashkent, 12–13 October 2026.
